about.title: About Zenvq Suggests
about.subtitle: We're building the cybersecurity advisor small businesses deserve.
about.missionDesc: Small businesses face the same cyber threats as enterprises but don't have the budget for a dedicated security team. Zenvq Suggests bridges that gap with honest, problem-first recommendations that fit your actual situation — not your wallet size.
about.howWeReviewDesc: Every product goes through independent editorial evaluation. We score on real-world effectiveness, ease of setup, value for money, and support quality. Commission never affects our rankings.
about.transparency1: We clearly label affiliate links and direct links
about.transparency2: Products without affiliate programs are still recommended if they're the best fit
about.transparency3: All editorial scores are based on hands-on evaluation

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Desc: When you use our diagnostic tool or sign up for recommendations, we collect your email address and the answers you provide in the diagnostic questionnaire. We also collect anonymous usage data through cookies and analytics.
privacy.s2Desc: We use your email to deliver your personalized security recommendations. If you explicitly opt in to marketing communications (checkbox is unchecked by default), we may send periodic cybersecurity tips and product updates. We never sell your data to third parties.
privacy.s3Desc: We use a secure, httpOnly cookie to remember returning visitors so you don't have to re-enter your email on gated pages. We also use analytics cookies to understand site usage patterns.
privacy.s4Desc: Some links on our site are affiliate links. When you click on an affiliate link and make a purchase, we may receive a commission. This never affects our editorial rankings or recommendations. Products are always ranked by fit score and editorial evaluation, never by commission amount.
privacy.s5Desc: You can request deletion of your data at any time by contacting us. You can unsubscribe from marketing emails using the link in any email we send. You can clear your browser cookies to remove your session.
privacy.s6Desc: For privacy-related inquiries, please contact us at privacy@zenvq.com.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1Desc: By accessing and using Zenvq Suggests, you agree to these terms of service. If you do not agree, please do not use the site.
terms.s2Desc: Zenvq Suggests provides cybersecurity product recommendations and educational content for small businesses. Our recommendations are based on editorial evaluation and are intended as guidance, not professional security consulting.
terms.s3Desc: Zenvq Suggests earns revenue through affiliate commissions when you purchase products through our links. We clearly label affiliate links. Commission never influences our editorial rankings — products are ranked solely by fit score and editorial evaluation.
terms.s4Desc: Zenvq Suggests provides recommendations in good faith but does not guarantee the security of any product or combination of products. We are not liable for any damages resulting from your use of recommended products.
terms.s5Desc: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the site constitutes acceptance of updated terms.
